name: Buddy Matty's Unofficial Home Depot Cabinet
notes: Donated by our Buddy Matty who overheard us talking about the site and builder bounties and rushed overnight to Home Depot stayed up until 4 am waking everyone up yelling things like .. Ah ha! It's a buzzer beater! We really thought he was playing NBA Jam all night yelling things like KABOOM and HE'S ON FIRE but he was really just talking to or about himself... and concocting this device that he woke us up at sunrise over asking for prize money thinking he had just won some sort of charity contest. So we explained to him... no Matthew, thats for children, you know, at our partners locations and all. He started flailing his arms shouting...I knew you guys were full of it. Questioning the very essence of our being and our integrity then saying we are bad friends and we talked him down we were like Matty its low effort but its still cool even with the cardboard marquee and sharpee Pacman you drew on it, and since you made it yourself its very special. That calmed him down quite a bit, but he insisted we call him the champion or just champ, for the rest of the year, and write it on our site. We cannot do that Matt, you might be our champ but you are not the official champion of any contest that hasn't even started; you are an adult bud, so you cannot be a prize contestant or recipient in a childrens contest... plus you overhearing us talking about it before any public notice and us rewarding you would be totally unethical you should exercise some common sense and honesty especially amongst your friends and their projects. Thank you, anyhow, for doing a good deed even if it took you staying up all night and thinking that you are winning some imaginary contest and lost treasure in your head, great work but again just to clarify for legal purposes since at one point you crashed out and you were threatening suing; there is no contest especially one where you are eligible to win some prize that hasn't been announced yet (that you weren't supposed to even be eavesdropping in on from the other room in the first place), nice (low effort) try though like this cabinet buddy. Anyways in all seriousness now we have to actually thank you for Buddy Matty's Overnight Unofficial Champion Unofficial Home Depot Arcade. Hope you're happy now its refreshing to see you do some good once every century.
